Trains to Headcorn

This is the train I would look at for the Headcorn Airshow. Headcorn station is on the Southeastern line between London Charing Cross and Ashford International, about an hour from London, with trains calling at London Bridge, Tonbridge and Paddock Wood on the way. The aerodrome is about 1.5 miles away, so it’s a 5 minute taxi ride, a short hop on the number 12 bus, or about a 30 minute walk.
